verdict.rationale: SCIM appears only as a bullet item ('SCIM New') on the pricing page listing enterprise features, with no documentation describing how SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning actually works, how groups sync, or how IdP-triggered deprovisioning revokes app access. Missing for 10: dedicated SCIM configuration docs, deprovisioning behavior details, group sync specifics, and any independent/hands-on confirmation it works as described.
